description: Physical goods with no exemption (the default category)
Clothing and shoes; Washington has no clothing exemption
Food and food ingredients, including candy and gum (RCW 82.08.0293)
Food heated or mixed by the seller, or sold with utensils (excluded from the food exemption)
Sweetened non-alcoholic drinks; not drinks with milk or over 50% juice (excluded from the food exemption)
Bottled water (excluded from the food exemption)
Vitamins and supplements sold without a prescription
Over-the-counter medicine sold without a prescription
Downloaded or streamed music, movies, books and similar
Prewritten software, downloaded or used online (remote access software / SaaS)
Delivery charges are taxed in the same share as the goods delivered (by price)
